headline: Top return reason by total refund amount
question: Which return reason costs us the most?

approach: Sum refund amounts for each return reason
Order reasons by total refund descending
Select the reason with the highest total refund
Round the total refund to two decimal places
report.headline: Top return reason by total refund amount
report.intent: You want to see which return reason has the highest total refund cost.
report.sql: SELECT reason, ROUND(SUM(refund_eur), 2) AS sum_refund_eur FROM luxexperience.returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY sum_refund_eur DESC LIMIT 1
